name: services/statements/statement_declarations
description: Get information of a multiple statement declarations.
brief_description: Get information of a multiple statement declarations.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of statement_declaration method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary: your declaration_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain the description of one statement declaration, as defined in the statement_declaration method.

For invalid declaration_ids (declarations which do not exist) null will be returned (instead of the declaration object).
